revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - I cannot see τὸ̣ν either, but I have no alternative to offer. No further comment. A much improved text.

Vote - AcceptText - Lines 1, 2, 17–20 OK. Line 7: OK, but the papyrus has ποήσις, not ποιήσις. Line 16: ἤδη is good, but the τό̣ν after it (a remnant of Brashear’s reading) is very difficult. If retained, perhaps τ̣ο̣ν̣? In finalizing, please also correct l. 4, παρ᾽, and l. 10, α[ὐτοὺ]ς
Submit - Corrections, restoration, addition of missing/omitted lines.

Commit - Corrections: l. 1 the name must be Κόμων (cf. bipartite kappa in καλῶς l. 2); in l. 2 restored the Aor.Particip. πέμψας instead of πέμψων (cf. l. 7 δοὺς); in l. 7 the papyrus has ποήσις not ποήσας; in l. 16 I read the more mundane ἤδη, what follows is unclear. Further, I've added the upsilon after ἀποπρ ̣ ̣υ omitted in the DDbDP, and finally I've added lines 17-19 + the verso, which were also omitted here.
changed schema; added xml:space=preserve; indented; moved title/@n to idno
Converted from TEI P4 (EpiDoc DTD v. 6) to P5 (EpiDoc RNG schema)
